title: Algebraically and geometrically minimal DG-models of diagrams of spaces
summary: We extend Sullivan's rational homotopy theory by constructing geometrically and algebraically minimal models for diagrams of simply connected spaces over a class of finite indexing categories. Both classes classify rational diagram homotopy types, but their minimality conditions can differ. We also show that, in contrast to classical rational homotopy theory, H-diagrams need not split into products of Eilenberg--MacLane diagrams, and characterize the indexing categories for which every H-diagram admits such a splitting.
